title: Bears Make a Comeback, but Recession Fears Are Overblown
description: The article discusses the recent global market selloff, which the author believes is largely driven by the unwinding of the yen-carry trade rather than fears of an impending recession. The author argues that while the economy is slowing, it is still in expansion mode, and the Federal Reserve is likely to intervene if the situation worsens.

title: Yen Carry Trade Fallout Could Keep Markets Pinned for a While Longer
description: The unwinding of the Japanese yen carry trade has sparked a global market sell-off, as the sudden appreciation of the yen forced the liquidation of leveraged positions. This event could keep markets under pressure for some time, as investors navigate the fallout and prepare for a potential economic slowdown.
